explication: Keiyoushi Extensions is a repository of manga and comic-source integrations for compatible reader apps, plus shared source and networking utilities. The principal workflow is a reader app requesting a source’s catalog or search results, then manga details, chapters, and page/image data from an external provider. Shared source abstractions and parsing helpers support these integrations. The graph shows representative implementations rather than every source; arrows are limited to relationships documented in the README or visible in the supplied source index and excerpts.
